name: quirk-cooldown-ring
intent: Capability readiness ring: idle ARMED at 100% full stroke; Run drains COOLDOWN with ticking percent; settle READY at 0% empty ring with accent ticks.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Skip drain; immediately show READY label, 0%, empty accent ring and accent ticks

acceptance: Idle shows ARMED and 100% with full primary ring and four angular tick caps
Run sets COOLDOWN and drains strokeDashoffset 0→289.03 over 580ms while percent ticks toward 0%
Completion shows READY, 0%, empty accent ring for 320ms ready-flash then done
Replay returns to ARMED 100% then re-runs drain
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows READY 0% immediately with no drain animation
No network; effect stays inside clipped stage
